issue.title: JSON output for bob ref create reporting the typed ingest outcome

task_type_fields.proposal: Give `bob ref create` a machine-readable JSON output that reports the typed ingest outcome (created with pdf, ref_type, title, and route; already in library; already queued; or a typed error kind with a retryable flag), so agents and Bob Mac Capture can call create directly. `-f` already means `--force` on create, so the option needs another spelling, chosen under the JSON-option convention that bob-cli-4a is settling. The human output and exit codes must stay byte-identical.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: bob-cli-52 put `ref create` JSON output out of scope (plan:202610/url_capture_ref_routing.md, Out of scope). It needs a flag-naming decision that belongs to bob-cli-4a's JSON-option policy. Proposed by bob-cli-52.9 note #6.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-52 left ref create JSON out of scope because it needs a non -f flag spelling; its verify phase proposed it as a follow-up (bob-cli-52.9 note #6).

payload.entry: RELATED: bob-cli-4a (unify Bob JSON-output option conventions) decides the flag spelling this needs. Typed artifact links are currently rejected by artifact-link event-store corruption.
